column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease three 8- or 9-inch round pans, line with parchment and grease again.
Whisk the cake flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar on high for 5 minutes until fluffy. Add the oil and beat 1 minute.
Beat in the eggs, egg whites and vanilla on medium-high until combined.
Add the dry ingredients and buttermilk in three alternating additions, mixing just until incorporated. Gently fold in the rainbow jimmies; do not use nonpareils.
Spread the batter evenly among the pans.
Bake 25–26 minutes for 9-inch pans or 27–28 minutes for 8-inch pans, tenting with foil after 15 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pans for 20 minutes, then turn out onto racks to cool completely.
